name: FUSIDICUID / BETAMETHASONE 20/1MG CREAM 15 GR 1 PIECE
description: The cream containing fusidic acid 20 mg/g and betamethasone 1 mg/g is a prescription medication. It is used to treat inflammatory skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis, that are also infected with bacteria. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
